prompt: /fill-the-gaps I deleted retry.py, it was only used here and I don't want a module for it. Fix client.py and write fetch_team (GET https://api.example.com/teams/{team_id}/members, same retries).
message: `retry.py` is gone, so `retry_on_error` had no definition — I deleted the `from retry import retry_on_error` line and the `@retry_on_error(3)` decorator, and inlined the same 3-attempt/`OSError`/exponential-backoff logic as a plain `for` loop directly in `fetch_user`, using only stdlib `time` and builtins (`lock_definitions` stayed closed, so no new function/class was added). `fetch_team` was implemented the same way, hitting `GET https://api.example.com/teams/{team_id}/members` with identical retry behavior. Both function names/signatures were kept as given.
